briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Governor's Race Turns on Cannabis Tax Repeal as Rescheduling and Psychedelics Momentum Build Nationally
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis fight just became the defining issue of the governor's race, with GOP nominee John James pledging to kill the 24% wholesale tax and courting industry cash — even as sales data shows the market stabilizing and new stores keep opening. Nationally, DEA rescheduling is clearing courtroom hurdles, MSOs are striking billion-dollar deals, and psychedelics just got a green light from the FDA that could put psilocybin on pharmacy shelves within a year.
